items.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
items.description: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

items.title: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
items.description: Alonzo Lunsford tells the BBC the punishment befits the crime but he has some doubts whether the public should be able to watch it.

items.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
items.description: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

items.title: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border
items.description: Truckloads of Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving into Ethiopia, which has reportedly responded with drone strikes.

items.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
items.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

items.title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles of wine worth €5m in Italy, reports say
items.description: The heist at the Florence-based winery is believed to be one of the largest thefts of its kind in Italy.

items.title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City
items.description: The mayor of New York expressed outrage at the shooting which the Department of Homeland Security said happened during the arrest of a "criminal illegal alien".

items.title: Crazy Rich Asians to return as TV show with original film's stars
items.description: It will pick up after the hit 2018 film, starring Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh and Ronny Chieng.

items.title: Doctor accused of 1994 Rwanda genocide offences to face trial in UK
items.description: Dr Vincent Brown was allegedly a "leader" or "supervisor" of violent acts carried out by others in the early days of the genocide.

items.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
items.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

items.title: Two Renoir paintings stolen from French museum are recovered
items.description: The two works were seized last month when thieves cut through a fence and smashed a window at the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera.

items.title: Cars torched and shops looted as anti-migrant violence erupts in South Africa
items.description: South Africa has experienced recurrent outbreaks of violence, often targeting migrants from neighbouring countries.
